screen.pinspo.search_prompt: Type something to search Pinterest, then click a pin to use it as your reference.
screen.pinspo.remove_hint: Left-click to use as your reference, right-click to remove it
screen.pinspo.no_saved: Nothing saved here yet — right-click a pin in Search to save it.
screen.pinspo.recent_hint: Left-click to pin it again, right-click to send or save it.
screen.pinspo.share_copied: Copied a share code for %s references to your clipboard.
screen.pinspo.import_failed: No PinSpo share code found on your clipboard.
screen.pinspo.choosing_file: Pick a file in the window that just opened.
screen.pinspo.bad_link: That is not an image link PinSpo can use — Discord and Pinterest links work.
screen.pinspo.bad_file: That file is not an image PinSpo can read.
screen.pinspo.no_link: Paste an image link into the box first.
screen.pinspo.pin_page_not_saveable: Pin it first, then right-click it in Recent to save it into a folder.
screen.pinspo.local_hint: Your screenshots and imported images — left-click to use one, right-click to send or save it.
screen.pinspo.no_local_images: Nothing here yet — paste an image link or pick a file from your computer.
screen.pinspo.not_shareable: Only Pinterest references can be sent to friends.
screen.pinspo.no_friends: No friends yet — type a player's name above and press + to ask them.
screen.pinspo.request_offline: Saved the request for %s — it goes out when you are on a server.
screen.pinspo.request_waiting: Waiting for your request to be accepted.
screen.pinspo.no_friends_selected: Add a friend on the left to start a chat.
screen.pinspo.no_messages: No messages yet — say hi or send your reference.
screen.pinspo.bad_name: That is not a valid Minecraft name.
screen.pinspo.send_failed: Could not send — you have to be on a server that allows /msg.
screen.pinspo.friends_hint: Click a reference to put it on your screen, right-click it to send or save it. Right-click a friend to unfriend or block them.
screen.pinspo.friends_empty_hint: Add the Minecraft name of a friend who also has PinSpo.
screen.pinspo.nothing_to_send: Pin a reference first, then send it.
screen.pinspo.send_copied: Copied a share code — paste it to your friend.
screen.pinspo.pin_actions_hint: Pick a friend to send it to, or a folder to keep it in.
screen.pinspo.open_home: Click PinSpo for your home feed
screen.pinspo.no_friends_yet: No friends yet — add a player name below.
screen.pinspo.no_folders_yet: No folders yet — name one below.
screen.pinspo.save_hint: Left-click to use as your reference, right-click to send or save it
message.pinspo.pin_failed: PinSpo: could not download that image.
key.pinspo.wall: Wall photo: place / move (sneak to edit)
screen.pinspo.wall_need_pin: Pin an image first, then put it on any wall, floor or ceiling.
screen.pinspo.wall_how: Look at a wall and press %s (or the button) to stick your pin on it.
screen.pinspo.wall_status: %s blocks wide, %s%% opacity. Only you can see it.
screen.pinspo.wall_status_shared: %s blocks wide, %s%% opacity. Your PinSpo friends see it too.
screen.pinspo.wall_place: Put on the wall I'm looking at
screen.pinspo.wall_hint_keys: Arrows move it, Page Up/Down bring it forward or back, R rotates. Hold Shift for full blocks
screen.pinspo.wall_hint_scroll: Scroll over the world to resize, Ctrl + scroll to bring it forward or back
message.pinspo.wall_look: Look at a block to put the photo on it.
message.pinspo.wall_need_pin: Pin an image first (press M), then put it on a wall.
message.pinspo.wall_placed: Photo placed. Press %s again to move it, sneak + %s to edit.
message.pinspo.wall_moved: Photo moved. Sneak + %s to edit it.
message.pinspo.wall_not_shareable: Only Pinterest images can be shared; files from your PC stay on your screen.
message.pinspo.wall_no_friends: Add PinSpo friends in the Friends tab to share a wall photo.
camera.pinspo.name: Camera %s
screen.pinspo.camera_how: Stand where you want a view and press %s. Each camera gets its own live window; sneak + the key to move, resize or zoom them.
screen.pinspo.camera_layout_hint: Drag to move · red corner resizes · scroll zooms · right-click resets zoom · × deletes
screen.pinspo.camera_layout_empty: No cameras showing. Press %s in-game to plant one.
message.pinspo.camera_planted: %s planted. Sneak + %s to move or resize its window.
message.pinspo.camera_full: You already have %s cameras here. Delete one in the Build tab (M).
message.pinspo.camera_failed: PinSpo: the camera view hit an error and was turned off. Please send your latest.log.
screen.pinspo.colour_how: Pick any pixel of a photo and get the blocks closest to that colour.
screen.pinspo.colour_empty: Choose a file or use your pinned image.
key.pinspo.hologram: Hologram line: add point (sneak to finish)
screen.pinspo.fog_note: %s flips all fog at once. Distance is the haze at the edge of your render distance, Sky covers weather and the Nether, Blindness also covers darkness.
screen.pinspo.far_note: Draws mobs, players, item frames, chests, signs, banners and heads much further away than normal. A server only sends you entities within its own range, so very far ones can still be missing.
screen.pinspo.camera_range_note: Cameras can see every chunk your game has loaded. To see even further, raise Render Distance in Video Settings.
screen.pinspo.camera_keys: Go teleports you into the camera (%s goes to the next one). Shot saves the window to your screenshots folder (%s does all of them).
screen.pinspo.camera_go_denied: Go needs /tp: singleplayer with cheats on, or op on a server.
screen.pinspo.camera_none_here: No cameras here yet. Press %s where you want a view.
screen.pinspo.holo_how: Press %s to drop a point where you look; each press joins onto the last. Aim at an existing point to link to it. Sneak + %s finishes the line.
screen.pinspo.shade_how: Look at a block and press %s (or use the button). Slide from darkest to brightest and the matching blocks around it turn into that shade.
screen.pinspo.shade_open: Shade the block I'm looking at
screen.pinspo.shade_ready: Shades come from your resource pack's real block colours.
screen.pinspo.macros_how: Macros type for you: chat lines, or /commands, on a key combo. Once sends them, Toggle repeats until you press again, Hold repeats while you hold the key.
screen.pinspo.keys_how: Rebind any of these with Change keys, under the PinSpo heading. Macro keys are set on the Macros page.
screen.pinspo.macro_hint: Esc while picking a key clears it. Repeats stay slow enough that servers won't kick you.
screen.pinspo.shade_live: Let go of the slider (or click a block above) and it applies straight away.
screen.pinspo.shade_press_apply: Pick a shade, then press Apply.
message.pinspo.shade_loading: PinSpo is reading block textures, try again in a second.
message.pinspo.shade_not_full: %s isn't a full block, so it has no shade palette.
message.pinspo.camera_none: No cameras here. Press %s to plant one.
message.pinspo.camera_tp_denied: This world doesn't let you use /tp, so PinSpo can't teleport you.
message.pinspo.camera_shot_wait: Camera views are still starting, try again in a moment.
message.pinspo.holo_start: Line started · %s adds points · sneak to finish
message.pinspo.reference_none: Nothing pinned yet. Press %s to find a reference.
